fixed: Undoing an import no longer leaves behind a choreographer the import created. When the imported dance had already been shared to another device it is kept as a deletion record, and those records no longer count as crediting the choreographer.
Undoing a shared archive import no longer removes a venue that a retained program still points at.

Referential delete guards for choreographers, tags' sources, custom fields, difficulty levels and venues now count only live owners, matching the sync-side citation check and the schema contract that a purge refuses an entity referenced by a live record.
VenueRepository.hardDelete retains venues still named by any surviving program row, since programs.venue_id is not a foreign key and the program writer rejects a dangling reference.
